title: 第十九章 羁绊
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
听到男子这般说道，夜如明倒是皱起了眉头，按照他的估算自己在到达夔龙变第五变时候，应该就有匹敌平阳千流和夔穷二人的肉身之力但想不到即使这样也不能修炼至尊法身。

    说完，她便再一次哭了起来，泪水直流，直接冲出房间，冲出顾家院，带着哭腔跑远了。

    一袭黑衣勾勒出其完美的曲线，配上其近乎完美的脸庞，让人目光难以从其身上移开。

    孙老夫人的眼皮肉眼可见的眨了眨。徐可可猜她现在心里肯定想不通，这事跟驻军有什么关系。

    他希望自己能够记住唐纤玉离去的带给自己的伤痕，然后激励自己，让自己足够强大，保护自己在乎的人。

    就比如那个长得稍微像点人形的叫什么阿剌诺斯，旁边好像是他的母亲，叫盖娅，长得也是一言难尽。白泽长得还是比较顺眼的，羊的脑袋，山羊胡，山羊角，身子确是狮子，一头白狮子，卖相不错。

    面对这样拥有着这样恐怖的法身的神使，妖族半神怎么可能有胜算？

    原来他们早就撩到张冲会等不及，迫不及待，所以一早就起来等着张冲的到来。

    不过如今父亲完成了他的意愿，但是这件事算得上已经圆满的画上句号了么？

    楚源打量着四周，惊讶的发现这里和弗莱迪所在的位置并不一样。

    这种感情和友情的感觉不一样，是一种迷恋却又压抑，得不到却又期待的复杂纠结。他相信自己的直觉，林玄对陈晨的爱，绝对不是朋友之间，兄弟之间的那种感情。

    那人猛地变换了一下动作姿态，气质也瞬间变得沉稳起来，低声训斥着说道。

    洛夏微微一愣，这才想起自己还有这么一个身份，实在是因为自己还没有真正去履行这个职务，而且还有关于渡劫这样关乎自身的重要事情，因此完全将此事给忘记了。

    他们注定就是不凡的，冬日是一年中最闲暇的时候，农田不用耕种，果树不会抽芽，所有人都像熊一样冬眠，他们却在闲暇时忙着提升自己的实力。
content_en:
Hearing what the man said, Ye Ruming frowned. According to his estimation, when he reached the fifth form of Kui Long Transformation, he should have the physical strength to rival Pingyang Qianliu and Kui Qiong, but he did not expect that even so, he would not be able to cultivate the Supreme Dharmakaya.

    After saying that, she started crying again, tears streaming down her face, and rushed out of the room, out of Gu's courtyard, and ran away with a cry in her voice.

    A black dress outlines his perfect curves, and coupled with his almost perfect face, it is difficult to take eyes away from him.

    Mrs. Sun's eyelids visibly blinked. Xu Keke guessed that she must not be able to figure out what this matter has to do with the garrison.

    He hoped that he could remember the scars caused by Tang Xianyu's departure, and then motivate himself to be strong enough to protect the people he cared about.

    For example, the one who looks slightly humanoid is called Aranos, and next to him seems to be his mother, named Gaia, whose appearance is also difficult to describe. Bai Ze's appearance is quite pleasing to the eye, with a sheep's head, goatee, goat horns, and the body of a lion, a white lion, which looks good.

    Facing such a divine envoy with such a terrifying dharma body, how could the demon demigod have any chance of winning?

    It turned out that they had already teased Zhang Chonghui and couldn't wait any longer, so they got up early in the morning to wait for Zhang Chong's arrival.

    But now that my father has fulfilled his wish, can this matter be considered a successful conclusion?

    Chu Yuan looked around and was surprised to find that this place was different from where Freddy was.

    This feeling is different from friendship. It is a complex tangle of infatuation but depression, not getting it but expecting it. He believed in his intuition. Lin Xuan's love for Chen Chen was definitely not the kind of feeling between friends or brothers.

    The man suddenly changed his movements and posture, his temperament instantly became calm, and he scolded in a low voice.

    Luo Xia was stunned for a moment, and then he remembered that he still had such an identity. It was because he had not really performed this duty yet, and there was such an important thing about himself as overcoming the tribulation, so he completely forgot about it.

    They are destined to be extraordinary. Winter is the most leisurely time of the year. Farmland does not need to be cultivated, fruit trees do not bud, and everyone hibernates like bears, but they are busy improving their strength in their free time.
